record.Description: This recall involves Qpancy-branded matching pajama sets. They include children’s pajamas that consist of a long-sleeve, button-front top with a front pocket and shorts, and matching pajamas for dolls. The sets were sold in multicolored cat, pink bow, pink and white striped bow, and pink and white stripes, and in sizes 120 (4–5T) through 150 (10–11Y). The brand is printed on a neck label and the size on a sewn-in side-seam label.
record.Title: Qpancy Recalls Children’s Pajama Sets Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Burn Hazard; Violate Mandatory Standards for Children’s Sleepwear

Hazards.Name: The recalled children’s pajama sets violate the mandatory safety standards for children’s sleepwear posing a risk of serious burn injuries.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should stop using the recalled pajama sets immediately and contact Qpancy for a full refund. Consumers will be asked to cut the pajama in half and send a photo of the destroyed pajamas to qpancyrecall@outlook.com. Consumers should then dispose of the destroyed product.
